if ! command -v zsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends zsh

jq --version
script --version
for suite in \
  test-claude-profile-lane-default \

  test-claude-tmux-statusline \

done
git_2_34_runs:
docker run --rm \
  --volume "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE:/workspace:ro" \
  --workdir /workspace \
  ubuntu:22.04@sha256:2edbbc5dc405e9612ba3584ce95480277e3eb374407b5505fe26f17df77c7dbc \
  bash -c 'apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends git=1:2.34.1-1ubuntu1 git-man=1:2.34.1-1ubuntu1 jq python3 zsh ca-certificates && git --version && test "$(git --version)" = "git version 2.34.1" && bash ./devBenches/devcontainer.test/test-speckit-git-feature.sh && bash ./devBenches/devcontainer.test/test-speckit-git-compat.sh'
bash_3_2_runs:
docker run --rm \
  --volume "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE:/workspace:ro" \
  --workdir /workspace \
  bash:3.2@sha256:241dd7ed99aa1f458b6a74cd200a49dca934d9e29d7a9b7636fe712db275a02b \
  -c 'apk add --no-cache git python3 coreutils jq >/dev/null && bash --version | sed -n "1p" && jq --version && bash ./devBenches/devcontainer.test/test-speckit-git-feature.sh && bash ./devBenches/devcontainer.test/test-speckit-git-compat.sh'
